input.description: Check whether output needs format fixes

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts')
import adhd_md as m
new = open('output.md').read()
old = open('input.md').read()
inv_new = m.extract_invariants(new, include_code=True)
inv_old = m.extract_invariants(old)
mn, an = m._diff_records(inv_old['numbers'], inv_new['numbers'], ('value',))
print('numbers missing:', mn, 'added:', an)
d = m.Doc(new)
for b in d.blocks:
    print(b.kind, b.start, repr(b.text[:90]))
"
